叶寒的悟性极高，在前世就快感悟到了剑域。

但他一直被卡在瓶颈，迟迟无法突破，让他的杀戮剑道无法再进一步。

如今，有了剑斗罗七杀剑域的指点，叶寒终于找到了打开这扇大门的钥匙，感悟到了专属于自己的杀戮剑域。

这是他将杀气和剑域完美融合的剑之领域。

不仅拥有杀戮的震慑，还有剑气的锐利。

噌！

一道剑鸣声响起。

叶寒的身上爆发出一股恐怖的杀戮剑意，迅速往周围蔓延，将方圆五米的范围变成一片充满杀戮的剑之领域。

在这里，他就是能任意夺走生命的杀神。

“领域之力！”

“怎么可能！”

宁风致、赵无极、唐三等人看到叶寒的变化，震惊不已。

领域是一种强大的专属能量场，是魂师对自身武魂、魂力和意志力的深度掌控。

在领域之中，魂师能够改写战斗规则，为自己加成，压制所有敌人的属性。

只要能感悟领域，就能拥有极强的战力，在同阶中几乎就是无敌的。

但想要感悟到领域，不仅需要极强的天赋和资质，还需要一些机遇。

哪怕是封号斗罗都不一定拥有领域。

但凡是感悟到领域的封号斗罗，都能成为顶尖强者，一身修为必定突破九十六级，成为世间罕有的超级斗罗。

叶寒能在这个年龄和修为感悟到领域，足以表明他的资质和天赋到底有多恐怖。

可以说是，叶寒已经拥有了成为一名超级斗罗的潜力，甚至还有希望突破九十九级极限斗罗，成为斗罗大陆的绝世强者。

“哈哈哈，好小子！”

“果然是剑道天才！”

“竟然能借助我的领域，感悟到自己的领域。”

“你是我见过资质最强的剑道天才。”

“叶寒，你可愿意拜我为师。”

“这一次，我可是真心想收徒，更想将我这一身本领交给你。”

剑斗罗感知到叶寒的杀戮领域，扬天狂笑，向他表明真心收徒的意愿。

叶寒的姿势和表现，正是他心目中梦寐以求的好徒弟。

“剑前辈，实在抱歉，你的剑道不适合我。”

“所以，我不能拜你为师。”

“刚才也多谢你的指点！”

叶寒收起剑域，有点虚弱地拒绝了剑斗罗的好意。

他走的是杀戮剑道，剑斗罗走的是从极致杀伐走向守护的七杀剑道。

看似，两者都属于杀伐类型的剑道。

但实际上，却存在这天壤之别的差距。

说白了，他的剑道是用来杀人的，而剑斗罗的剑道是用极致杀伐来守护身边的人。

就目前为止，叶寒是不会接受这种守护之路的。

他现在只想变强，成为这世间最强者。

“哎，好吧，你不想拜师，我也不强求。”

“但如果你想拜师了，一定要告诉我。”

“我愿意一直等你！”

剑斗罗见他拒绝了，满脸遗憾之色。

但不管怎样，他还是要为自己争取一个机会，把拜师的大门，始终向叶寒敞开。

“多谢前辈！”

叶寒感激了一句，向戴沐白缓缓走去。

戴沐白望着他那冰冷到极致的眸光，有点怕了，下意识地往后退了几步。

此时，叶寒的魂力和体力在祖龙血脉的作用下，以极快的速度恢复。

领域对魂力、体力和精神力的消耗太大了，还不是他现在能够轻易施展的。

刚才仅仅只维持了几秒钟，便让他有点吃不消。

如果不是有祖龙血脉打底，他刚才早就瘫坐在地了。

“叶寒，怎么了！”

赵无极注意到了叶寒的眸光，将他拦了下来。

Ye Han's understanding is extremely high, and he almost realized the sword realm in his previous life.

But he has been stuck in a bottleneck and has been unable to break through, making it impossible for him to go further with his killing swordsmanship.

Now, with the guidance of Sword Douluo's Seven Killing Sword Domain, Ye Han finally found the key to open this door and realized his own Killing Sword Domain.

This is the sword realm where he perfectly blends murderous intent and sword realm.

Not only does it have the shock of killing, but it also has the sharpness of sword energy.

bass!

A sword sound sounded.

A terrifying killing sword intent erupted from Ye Han's body, quickly spreading to the surrounding area, turning a five-meter radius into a sword field full of killing.

Here, he is the god of death who can take away lives at will.

"The power of the field!"

"How is that possible!"

Ning Fengzhi, Zhao Wuji, Tang San and others were shocked when they saw Ye Han's changes.

The domain is a powerful exclusive energy field, which is the soul master's deep control over his own martial soul, soul power and willpower.

In the domain, the soul master can rewrite the rules of combat, add bonuses to himself, and suppress the attributes of all enemies.

As long as you can comprehend the domain, you can have extremely strong combat power and be almost invincible at the same level.

But if you want to understand the field, you not only need strong talents and qualifications, but also some opportunities.

Even a titled Douluo may not have a domain.

Any titled Douluo who understands the realm can become a top powerhouse, and his cultivation level will definitely break through level ninety-six, becoming a rare super Douluo in the world.

The fact that Ye Han can comprehend the field at this age and cultivation level is enough to show how terrifying his qualifications and talents are.

It can be said that Ye Han already has the potential to become a super Douluo, and he even has the hope of breaking through the ninety-nineth level of Ultimate Douluo and becoming a peerless powerhouse in the Douluo Continent.

"Hahaha, good boy!"

"He is indeed a swordsman genius!"

"You can actually use my domain to understand your own domain."

"You are the most qualified swordsman genius I have ever seen."

"Ye Han, are you willing to become my teacher?"

"This time, I really want to recruit a disciple, and I want to hand over my skills to you."

Sword Douluo sensed Ye Han's killing field and laughed wildly, showing him his sincere intention to become a disciple.

Ye Han's posture and performance were exactly what he dreamed of being a good apprentice.

"Senior Jian, I'm really sorry, your swordsmanship is not suitable for me."

"So, I can't accept you as my teacher."

"Thank you for your advice just now!"

Ye Han put away his sword domain and rejected Sword Douluo's kindness a little weakly.

He followed the sword path of killing, while Sword Douluo followed the sword path of seven killings, from extreme killing to protection.

It seems that both belong to the killing type of swordsmanship.

But in fact, there is such a huge difference.

To put it bluntly, his kendo is for killing people, while Sword Douluo's kendo is for protecting those around him with extreme killing blows.

So far, Ye Han will not accept this path of guardianship.

Now he just wants to become stronger and become the strongest person in the world.

"Hey, okay, if you don't want to become a disciple, I won't force you."

"But if you want to become a disciple, you must tell me."

"I am willing to wait for you forever!"

Seeing his refusal, Sword Douluo had a look of regret on his face.

But no matter what, he still wanted to fight for a chance for himself and keep the door of apprenticeship open to Ye Han.

"Thank you, senior!"

Ye Han thanked him and walked slowly towards Dai Mubai.

Dai Mubai looked at his extremely cold eyes, a little scared, and subconsciously took a few steps back.

At this time, Ye Han's soul power and physical strength were restored at an extremely fast speed under the influence of Zulong's bloodline.

The domain consumes too much soul power, physical strength, and mental power, and it is not something he can easily use now.

It only lasted a few seconds, and it was a bit too much for him.

If it weren't for the ancestor dragon bloodline, he would have collapsed on the ground just now.

"Ye Han, what's wrong!"

Zhao Wuji noticed Ye Han's eyes and stopped him.
